item.title: S.F. supervisors vote to make it easier to serve booze at the movies
item.description: Supervisor Stephen Sherrill has made it easier to drink at the movies. San Francisco supervisors voted unanimously Tuesday to pass the District 2 supervisor’s ordinance that waives rules that put many San Francisco movie theaters at risk of being out of compliance with city code, should they serve alcohol. S.F. supervisors vote to make it easier to serve booze at the movies
